projek.nama: Tanya Darwish: Agentic AI Portfolio Assistant
poin: Built an AI agent with a hand-written agent loop and tool calling that answers recruiter questions with cited evidence from a knowledge base (RAG).
Developed a Telegram personal assistant that manages reminders, tasks and job-search preferences, with exact-time scheduling through a message queue.
Automated daily job discovery and job-match scoring, and generates tailored ATS-friendly resumes that are only sent after human approval.
Implemented guardrails (rate limiting, prompt-injection rules, input validation) and an automated evaluation suite to measure answer accuracy.
Deployed on a serverless stack (Netlify, Upstash) running at zero monthly cost.
